# `spell` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "spell" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/spell/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique spell id, e.g. "ember". Stable once shipped (saves). |
| `schemaVersion` | `1` | `1` | SpellDefinition schema version, for future migrations. |
| `name` | string | required | Display name, e.g. "Ember". |
| `school` | `"fire"` \| `"frost"` \| `"storm"` \| `"arcane"` \| `"illusion"` \| `"alteration"` \| `"conjuration"` \| `"necromancy"` \| `"nature"` \| `"light"` \| `"shadow"` \| `"gravity"` \| `"time"` \| `"somnomancy"` | required | School of magic. |
| `tier` | integer 1–5 | required | Step in its verb chain: 1 is a first verb, higher tiers follow on from it. |
| `next` | list of ref → spell | `[]` | Follow-on verbs this spell leads to (unlock rules: e07.8). |
| `cost` | object | required | What a cast costs. |
| `cost.mana` | number ≥ 0 | required | Mana spent when the cast releases. |
| `castTime` | number ≥ 0 | required | Wind-up seconds before release; 0 = instant. |
| `channel` | object | — | Present for channelled spells (held after release, e06.4). |
| `channel.interval` | number > 0 | required | Seconds between channel ticks; effects apply each tick. |
| `channel.manaPerSecond` | number ≥ 0 | required | Mana drained per second while channelled. |
| `channel.maxDuration` | number > 0 | required | Longest it can be channelled, seconds. |
| `cooldown` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Seconds after release before it can be cast again. |
| `delivery` | object | required | How the spell reaches its targets; effect ops apply to what it reaches. |
| `delivery.kind` | `"self"` | required |  |
| `delivery.kind` | `"touch"` | required |  |
| `delivery.reach` | number > 0 | `1.5` | How far from the caster it can touch, metres. |
| `delivery.kind` | `"projectile"` | required |  |
| `delivery.speed` | number > 0 | required | Flight speed, metres per second. |
| `delivery.maxRange` | number > 0 | required | Distance after which it fizzles, metres. |
| `delivery.radius` | number > 0 | required | Collision radius, metres. |
| `delivery.gravity` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Downward acceleration, m/s²; 0 flies straight, 9.81 arcs like a stone. |
| `delivery.kind` | `"aoe"` | required |  |
| `delivery.shape` | object | required | Area shape: sphere, cone, line (wall) or ground decal. |
| `delivery.shape.kind` | `"sphere"` | required |  |
| `delivery.shape.radius` | number > 0 | required | Radius, metres. |
| `delivery.shape.kind` | `"cone"` | required |  |
| `delivery.shape.length` | number > 0 | required | Reach along the aim direction, metres. |
| `delivery.shape.angle` | number > 0 ≤ 180 | required | Full opening angle, degrees (at most 180). |
| `delivery.shape.kind` | `"line"` | required |  |
| `delivery.shape.length` | number > 0 | required | Length along the aim direction, metres. |
| `delivery.shape.width` | number > 0 | required | Width, metres. |
| `delivery.shape.height` | number > 0 | required | Height, metres (a wall of fire is tall; a trail of frost is not). |
| `delivery.shape.kind` | `"decal"` | required |  |
| `delivery.shape.radius` | number > 0 | required | Radius of the ground patch, metres. |
| `delivery.origin` | `"caster"` \| `"aim"` | `"caster"` | Centred on the caster or the aim point. |
| `delivery.range` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Farthest aim point from the caster, metres (0 for caster-centred areas). |
| `delivery.lineOfSight` | boolean | `false` | Only targets with line of sight to the centre are affected. |
| `delivery.kind` | `"beam"` | required |  |
| `delivery.length` | number > 0 | required | Beam reach, metres. |
| `delivery.width` | number > 0 | required | Beam width, metres. |
| `delivery.maxBounces` | integer 0–8 | `0` | Reflections off reflective surfaces before it stops (0–8). |
| `delivery.kind` | `"summonPoint"` | required |  |
| `delivery.range` | number > 0 | required | Farthest point from the caster it can be placed at, metres. |
| `delivery.lineOfSight` | boolean | `true` | The point must be visible from the caster. |
| `effects` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Effect ops, applied in order to what it reaches. |
| `effects[].amounts` | map of `"slash"` \| `"pierce"` \| `"blunt"` \| `"fire"` \| `"frost"` \| `"shock"` \| `"arcane"` \| `"poison"` → number ≥ 0 | required | Damage points per damage type (before resistances); unlisted types deal 0. |
| `effects[].poiseDamage` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Poise damage in points. |
| `effects[].staminaDamage` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Stamina drained from a blocker, in points (before shield stability). |
| `effects[].impulse` | object | `{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0}` | Knockback impulse, N·s, in the attacker’s frame (+z forward, +y up). |
| `effects[].impulse.x` | number | required |  |
| `effects[].impulse.y` | number | required |  |
| `effects[].impulse.z` | number | required |  |
| `effects[].impactForce` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Peak impact force, N (breakables, knockdown). |
| `effects[].tags` | list of id | `[]` | Damage-packet tags every hit carries, e.g. "critical" (damage model tags). |
| `effects[].op` | `"damage"` | required |  |
| `effects[].op` | `"stimulus"` | required |  |
| `effects[].element` | `"heat"` \| `"cold"` \| `"water"` \| `"charge"` \| `"force"` \| `"gas"` \| `"light"` \| `"blunt"` \| `"slash"` \| `"pierce"` | required | Stimulus element (stimulus API). |
| `effects[].intensity` | number ≥ 0 | required | Total amount at full falloff, in the element’s unit (°C, wetness, N·s, J…). |
| `effects[].radius` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Sphere radius around each hit point, metres; 0 = the delivery’s own contact/shape. |
| `effects[].duration` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Seconds to spread the intensity over; 0 = at once. |
| `effects[].falloff` | `"linear"` \| `"none"` | `"linear"` | Intensity falloff inside the shape (stimulus API): linear to the rim, or none. |
| `effects[].gas` | id | — | Gas type id; required for (and only for) element "gas". |
| `effects[].op` | `"force"` | required |  |
| `effects[].mode` | `"push"` \| `"pull"` \| `"impulse"` \| `"lift"` | required | push away, pull toward, directed impulse or sustained lift. |
| `effects[].impulse` | number > 0 | required | Impulse, N·s (per second for a sustained lift). |
| `effects[].duration` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Seconds a sustained force lasts; 0 = one impulse. |
| `effects[].op` | `"status"` | required |  |
| `effects[].status` | id | required | Status id, e.g. "rooted" (status definitions: e06.9). |
| `effects[].duration` | number > 0 | required | Seconds the status lasts. |
| `effects[].stacks` | integer 1–99 | `1` | Stacks applied. |
| `effects[].op` | `"summon"` | required |  |
| `effects[].creature` | ref → creature | required | Creature summoned. |
| `effects[].duration` | number > 0 | required | Seconds before it is dismissed. |
| `effects[].count` | integer 1–10 | `1` | How many one cast summons. |
| `effects[].maxActive` | integer 1–20 | `1` | Most alive per caster; summoning more dismisses the oldest. |
| `effects[].consumes` | object | — | World material the summon needs and uses up (e.g. property "remains"). |
| `effects[].consumes.property` | string | required | A canonical world property key (docs/design/world-properties.md). |
| `effects[].consumes.radius` | number > 0 | required | Search radius around the summon point, metres. |
| `effects[].consumes.count` | integer 1–10 | `1` | Entities with the property consumed. |
| `effects[].op` | `"transform"` | required |  |
| `effects[].into` | ref → creature | required | Creature form the target takes. |
| `effects[].duration` | number > 0 | required | Seconds before it changes back. |
| `effects[].op` | `"displace"` | required |  |
| `effects[].mode` | `"teleport"` \| `"swap"` \| `"dash"` | required | teleport to the aim point, swap with the target, or dash. |
| `effects[].distance` | number > 0 | required | Farthest displacement, metres. |
| `effects[].lineOfSight` | boolean | `true` | The destination must be visible. |
| `effects[].op` | `"spawnVolume"` | required |  |
| `effects[].shape` | object | required | Area shape: sphere, cone, line (wall) or ground decal. |
| `effects[].shape.kind` | `"sphere"` | required |  |
| `effects[].shape.radius` | number > 0 | required | Radius, metres. |
| `effects[].shape.kind` | `"cone"` | required |  |
| `effects[].shape.length` | number > 0 | required | Reach along the aim direction, metres. |
| `effects[].shape.angle` | number > 0 ≤ 180 | required | Full opening angle, degrees (at most 180). |
| `effects[].shape.kind` | `"line"` | required |  |
| `effects[].shape.length` | number > 0 | required | Length along the aim direction, metres. |
| `effects[].shape.width` | number > 0 | required | Width, metres. |
| `effects[].shape.height` | number > 0 | required | Height, metres (a wall of fire is tall; a trail of frost is not). |
| `effects[].shape.kind` | `"decal"` | required |  |
| `effects[].shape.radius` | number > 0 | required | Radius of the ground patch, metres. |
| `effects[].element` | `"heat"` \| `"cold"` \| `"water"` \| `"charge"` \| `"force"` \| `"gas"` \| `"light"` \| `"blunt"` \| `"slash"` \| `"pierce"` | required | Stimulus element the volume emits while it lasts. |
| `effects[].intensity` | number ≥ 0 | required | Amount per second at full falloff, in the element’s unit. |
| `effects[].duration` | number > 0 | required | Seconds the volume lasts. |
| `effects[].op` | `"light"` | required |  |
| `effects[].intensity` | number > 0 | required | Light output (a torch is about 100). |
| `effects[].radius` | number > 0 | required | Reach, metres. |
| `effects[].duration` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Seconds it shines; 0 = a flash. |
| `effects[].attach` | `"caster"` \| `"delivery"` \| `"point"` | `"delivery"` | Follows the caster, the delivery (projectile, beam) or stays at the hit point. |
| `effects[].op` | `"noise"` | required |  |
| `effects[].phase` | `"windup"` \| `"release"` \| `"impact"` | required | Cast phase it sounds in. |
| `effects[].loudness` | number > 0 | required | Hearing radius, metres, before sound propagation attenuates it. |
| `tags` | list of id | `[]` | Free tags for queries and dispel rules, e.g. "fire", "control". |
| `vfxCue` | string | required | VFX cue id (style bible §15.1). |
| `sfxCue` | string | required | Audio cue id (audio bible §6), without the round-robin number. |
| `bookId` | id | — | Book that teaches it (book items: e07.1); absent for spells no book teaches. |
| `flags` | object | `{}` | Design flags. |
| `flags.tooUseful` | boolean | `false` | Deliberately powerful: protected from balance nerfs (constitution §4). |
| `flags.castWhileMoving` | boolean | `false` | Moving does not interrupt its wind-up or channel (e06.4). |
